note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `meta` is a key-bag whose shape changes between rounds: the datasets-server infers `meta` from the thin `{factory, generator, round}` of `batch-r01.jsonl`, then dies casting later designed records with `{..., kind, seed, designed, domain, stack}`, so the parquet index is never built. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present on all 282 records and always a string; it is never a list and never absent in this dataset

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool — `command` (bash), `url` (fetch), `path` (read/edit/write), `path`+`args` (pytest), `old`/`new` (edit), `pattern` (grep), `contents` (write), `target`

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag with five observed shapes over 282 records: `success`, `tests_passed`, `cost_steps` on every record, plus `plan_changes` on 278, `retries` on 265, `duration_min` and `wasted_calls` on 262, and `handoff` / `xfailed` on 4

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag with three observed shapes over 282 records: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record; 268 add `kind`, `seed`, `designed`, `domain`, `stack`; 4 of those also add `lane`; 14 carry the thin three-key shape alone

disclosures: Every one of the 282 records is stamped `meta.factory` `queue-backpressure-factory` and `meta.generator` `grok-4.6`, and every record is an episode (`id`/`goal`/`plan`/`steps`/`outcome`/`reward`/`meta`). There is no unstamped payload and no kind mix.

disclosures.summary: 14 records carry a thin `meta` of `{factory, generator, round}` only, with no `kind`/`seed`/`designed`/`domain`/`stack`. They sit in `batch-r01` and `batch-r04`-`batch-r09` and define the shape datasets-server inferred; the cast fails on the later 268 designed records that add those fields. The thin records are kept exactly as generated.
4 records in `batch-r02` and `batch-r03` add a `meta.lane` of `b` that no other record has, and are also the 4 records whose `reward` omits `plan_changes`.

6 records in `batch-r74`-`batch-r76` are foreign search-index-rebuild leftover3c mill payload that wears this destination's stamp: their ids are `sir-*`, their `meta.domain` / `meta.stack` are Bleve / Lucene / pg_trgm index-rebuild subjects, and 3 of them carry the `handoff` / `xfailed` reward keys. Because `meta.factory` is dest-stamped `queue-backpressure-factory` and `meta.kind` is `episode`, neither the factory-mix detector nor the dest-field family-mix detector sees them. They are disclosed here rather than removed, and no raw record is rewritten. No GitHub issue currently owns this class: the frozen factory-mix census (#43) covers only email-webhook-retry, eval-harness, observability-debug and rag-retrieval-debug, and the dest-stamped census (#44) covers only cache-stampede, k8s-crashloop and rate-limit-backoff while explicitly setting `sir-*-leftover3c-*` rows aside as out of its scope.

disclosures: The remaining 276 `qbp-*` records are this factory's own advertised leftover-bound mechanic: 96 name `leftover` in the id and 196 name it in the goal, on the same `queue-backpressure-factory` that owns the dump. Same-factory leftover naming is a designed subject, not foreign payload, and those records are not a mill mix.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis` (4649 of 4649). There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
